description: This file defines the class CustomDosingInstructions, which implements the DosingInstructions interface and provides methods related to drug dosing instructions within the OpenMRS project. It contains method implementations including validation logic and placeholder methods.

classes.name: CustomDosingInstructions
classes.description: A class implementing the DosingInstructions interface, providing specific behavior for managing dosing instructions in the context of drug orders within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getDosingInstructionsAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of dosing instructions for a specific locale.

methods.name: setDosingInstructions
methods.description: Sets the dosing instructions for a given DrugOrder.

methods.name: getDosingInstructions
methods.description: Retrieves the dosing instructions for a specified DrugOrder.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the DrugOrder object, specifically checking that the 'brandName' field is not null.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Returns the expiration date for the given DrugOrder.
